description: This is a Java test source file for the DateUtils class, containing unit tests for date and time utilities in the Fineract project.

classes.name: DateUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit 5 test class for testing various static utility methods in the DateUtils class related to date/time handling based on tenant and system settings.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the tenant context and business date before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread local context after each test.

methods.name: getSystemZoneIdTest
methods.description: Tests if the system's default timezone is correctly returned by DateUtils.

methods.name: getDateTimeZoneOfTenant
methods.description: Verifies that the tenant's timezone is correctly returned.

methods.name: getLocalDateOfTenant
methods.description: Checks if the tenant's local date matches expected date.

methods.name: getLocalDateTimeOfTenant
methods.description: Verifies that the date-time of the tenant is correctly obtained and compares with current time.

methods.name: getOffsetDateTimeOfTenant
methods.description: Checks the offset date-time for tenant for correctness.

methods.name: isDateInTheFuture
methods.description: Tests whether specific dates are correctly identified as future dates.

methods.name: getBusinesLocalDate
methods.description: Checks if the business date matches expected value.
